name: spawn_model
title: Spawn Model
description: Create a game object with a ModelRenderer in one call - the fastest way to put a model in the scene. Optionally tint it, override its material, scale it and parent it. The user can undo this. Returns the new object's id.

name.description: The new object's name. Empty uses the model filename.

scale.description: Scale as 'x,y,z', or a single number for uniform.

material.description: Material asset path to override every surface with.

parent.description: Parent game object id. Empty parents to the scene root.
